instances.claim: This tells me that the cent's value has been made open-ended, undetermined and continually remade — the same point delivered four times.
instances.why: Lines 14 and 15 already establish the point in two distinct registers (object: the coin melted into an undefinable block; mechanism: value redefined by market consensus as the pieces trade), and 17 adds a third (form: what kind of thing CENTS is, a work that unfolds through its participants). Line 16's 'indeterminate value and emergent meaning' adds no fourth register — 'indeterminate' is a synonym for 14's 'undefinable' and 'emergent' for 15's 'continually redefined' — so it reads as a restatement placed between two lines that already carry it. I would keep 17 as the closing statement and cut 16, salvaging only the 'cracks open the worthless one-cent coin' image if a bridge into 17 is needed.
